column1: A stylish relic-themed tactical gacha with promising art and an active dev team, but it stumbles on core feel: slow, number-heavy battles with weak readability and automation, grindy progression gated by tight stamina, and a harsh, non-carryover pity. Heavy client size and rocky operations further drag reception. With QoL, clarity, and economy fixes, it could find a steadier audience.

column2: some complaints about sexualized, childlike-looking female designs and minor blood in story.
